assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Circle centred at O with radius 6 containing the circles centred at P (radius 2) and Q (radius 3), tangent to it at B and C and to each other at A; OP = 4 and OQ = 3 meet at a right angle at O, triangle ABC has the 135 degree angle at A, and a dashed arc of the circumcircle through C, A, B is centred at O' = (6, 6) with radius 6.

difficulty_rationale: One must notice the right angle at O from the 3-4-5 distances and then find angle BAC = 135 degrees by combining two angle relations.
